\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 212-215 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R220-first-pass-words-from-chapters-212-215}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a result and although.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to iron, to grind, to fry, to boil, to taste
  \item to deliver, to lift, to drop, to throw, to pull
  \item to hurry, to be late, to conceal, to earn, to look after
  \item to reduce, to chase, to trust, to doubt, to hate
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To iron? (\textbf{\ur{استری} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{istrī karnā}.) To grind? (\textbf{\ur{پیسنا}}, \emph{pīsnā}.) To fry? (\textbf{\ur{تلنا}}, \emph{talnā}.) To boil? (\textbf{\ur{ابالنا}}, \emph{ubālnā}.) To taste? (\textbf{\ur{چکھنا}}, \emph{chakhnā}.) To deliver? (\textbf{\ur{پہنچانا}}, \emph{pahuṅchānā}.) To lift? (\textbf{\ur{اٹھانا}}, \emph{uṭhānā}.) To drop? (\textbf{\ur{گرانا}}, \emph{girānā}.) To throw? (\textbf{\ur{پھینکنا}}, \emph{pheṅknā}.) To pull? (\textbf{\ur{کھینچنا}}, \emph{khīṅchnā}.) To hurry? (\textbf{\ur{جلدی} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{jaldī karnā}.) To be late? (\textbf{\ur{دیر} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{der karnā}.) To conceal? (\textbf{\ur{چھپانا}}, \emph{chhupānā}.) To earn? (\textbf{\ur{کمانا}}, \emph{kamānā}.) To look after? (\textbf{\ur{سنبھالنا}}, \emph{sambhālnā}.) To reduce? (\textbf{\ur{کم} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{kam karnā}.) To chase? (\textbf{\ur{پیچھا} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{pīchhā karnā}.) To trust? (\textbf{\ur{بھروسا} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{bharosā karnā}.) To doubt? (\textbf{\ur{شک} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{shak karnā}.) To hate? (\textbf{\ur{نفرت} \ur{کرنا}}, \emph{nafrat karnā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 216-220 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R220-second-pass-words-from-chapters-216-220}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a pulse and breath.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a pulse, breath, sleep, a dream, weakness
  \item a beard, a moustache, good health, a toothache, an itch
  \item September, October, November, December, Monday
  \item a flat, a storey; a destination, a staircase, a courtyard, a balcony
  \item fortunately, unfortunately, a reason, a result, although
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A pulse? (\textbf{\ur{نبض}}, \emph{nabz}.) Breath? (\textbf{\ur{سانس}}, \emph{sāṅs}.) Sleep? (\textbf{\ur{نیند}}, \emph{nīṅd}.) A dream? (\textbf{\ur{خواب}}, \emph{khvāb}.) Weakness? (\textbf{\ur{کمزوری}}, \emph{kamzorī}.) A beard? (\textbf{\ur{داڑھی}}, \emph{dāṛhī}.) A moustache? (\textbf{\ur{مونچھ}}, \emph{mūṅchh}.) Good health? (\textbf{\ur{تندرستی}}, \emph{tandurustī}.) A toothache? (\textbf{\ur{دانت} \ur{درد}}, \emph{dāṅt dard}.) An itch? (\textbf{\ur{کھجلی}}, \emph{khujlī}.) September? (\textbf{\ur{ستمبر}}, \emph{sitambar}.) October? (\textbf{\ur{اکتوبر}}, \emph{aktūbar}.) November? (\textbf{\ur{نومبر}}, \emph{navambar}.) December? (\textbf{\ur{دسمبر}}, \emph{disambar}.) Monday? (\textbf{\ur{سوموار}}, \emph{somvār}.) A flat? (\textbf{\ur{فلیٹ}}, \emph{flaiṭ}.) A storey; a destination? (\textbf{\ur{منزل}}, \emph{manzil}.) A staircase? (\textbf{\ur{زینہ}}, \emph{zīnā}.) A courtyard? (\textbf{\ur{آنگن}}, \emph{āṅgan}.) A balcony? (\textbf{\ur{بالکنی}}, \emph{bālkanī}.) Fortunately? (\textbf{\ur{خوش} \ur{قسمتی} \ur{سے}}, \emph{khush qismatī se}.) Unfortunately? (\textbf{\ur{بد} \ur{قسمتی} \ur{سے}}, \emph{bad qismatī se}.) A reason? (\textbf{\ur{وجہ}}, \emph{vajah}.) A result? (\textbf{\ur{نتیجہ}}, \emph{natījā}.) Although? (\textbf{\ur{حالانکہ}}, \emph{hālāṅki}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
